authority: Autonomous necessary technical preparation and isolated keyless engineering under the direct human delegation. No scientific-rule adoption, population reduction, keys or acquisition.
representation: Pure lexicographic rank/unrank of context subsets within a shape over the entire v31 ordered eligible base support; separate mixed-radix target index conditional on the subset. Per complete syntax configuration probability is exactly1/(M times product of selected target counts) if the external context rank and conditional target digits are uniform. No uniform complete-world rank replacement.
completion_proof: A sorted prefix partitions into next-index branches. No-shape: binomial of remaining indices. Clustered: only the prefix group may complete. Distributed: once two groups are present all remaining subsets allowed; while one group is present subtract its monochromatic completions. Empty prefix uses full binomial minus/sum per-group. All branches disjoint and exhaustive; induction yields a bijection even where groups interleave in global order.
toy_checks: All k1..8: no-shape, singleton for k1, clustered/distributed for k>=2. Exhaust every legal subset and all its target assignments. Check every unique prefix's next-index completion partition. Include empty shape cells, interleaved groups, no common group, one group and mixed target multiplicities. These synthetic integer objects are not RFL mechanism fixtures or science N.
production_probes: For all11 v31 cells, fixed unique ranks {0,1,2,M//3,M//2,M-3,M-2,M-1} within bounds; for each decoded subset fixed target indices {0,1,L//2,L-2,L-1} within bounds. These are arithmetic boundary/interior probes, not random samples, seeds, scientific/workload keys, collected worlds or coverage of every production rank.
negative_challenges: Reject bool/float/negative/out-of-range ranks, bad shape/k, duplicate/unsorted/out-of-range contexts, invalid target actions and target-code overflow, and unrank requests on empty cells. No mutation of frozen or executed source.
capture: One new candidate child and one separate stdlib stored-content checker child, exclusive evidence directories. Checker imports neither codec nor candidate/RFL; exhaustive small oracle uses itertools combinations/product; production rank check uses independent unrestricted combinadic rank minus monochromatic ranks. No automatic retry/overwrite.
limits: This closes syntax representation only. No keyed random variate, defect installer, exact failure-conditioned DGP/normalizer, native mechanism rollout, joint measurement/calibration/threshold, full-pre-state equivalence collapse, real collector, complete gates or dense resource certification. All old evidence and full noneligible catalog rows retained by binding; no scientific rules adopted.
